name: Row Aggregator
description: Adds row-wise aggregates over the selected numeric columns. sum adds the columns, mean divides their sum by the number of selected columns, min/max use LEAST/GREATEST, and count counts the non-NULL values. Input columns are kept. A NULL in any selected column makes sum, mean, min and max NULL for that row; count ignores NULLs.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: Numeric columns to aggregate. When omitted or empty, every numeric input column is used.

aggregations.title: Aggregations
aggregations.description: Aggregations computed for every row; each one produces one new column.

fn.title: Function
fn.description: Aggregate function applied across the selected columns.

output.title: Output column
output.description: Name of the new column; defaults to the function name.
